purpose: Canonical blocking-task ledger for PR #90. These tasks are deliberately separated so provenance, measurement-error identifiability, third-system replication, and Izu field causality cannot substitute for one another.

tasks.goal: Recover and checksum-lock exact Hendriks 2019 source bytes, then re-verify all 35 floral pairs and island assignments against those bytes.
Recover the source-native 136-pair Pacific floral table and determine whether a compatible third response-shape system can be reproduced.
Identify a defensible empirical floral measurement reliability source, or prove that reliability remains unidentifiable from available source-native materials.

Collect linked SVD, observation-effort, reproductive-treatment, fruit/seed and optional parentage data sufficient to estimate contemporary effective-pollinator dependency without conflating structural completion with confirmatory adequacy.

formal_cross_system_fit_gate.rule: Open only after compatible source-locked effects with uncertainty exist in at least two independent system clusters for the same effect family, with relevant provenance and measurement-error gates satisfied.

priority_rationale: Hendriks provenance and empirical reliability are the nearest blockers on already reconstructed evidence; the 136-pair source can add independent external replication; Issue #91 remains the decisive new empirical mechanism gate and proceeds as field data become available.
claim_boundary: This ledger tracks what must be completed before evidence is promoted. It does not itself change any biological result, effect-registry eligibility, causal claim, or formal model admission.
